model_version: pic2d v1.2 (v1.1 all-GPU step; operating point sized from the measured v2 kinetics)

operating_point.neutral_density_justification: sized from the v2 fine-w6e4 kinetics, not from the Bohm bound: the measured per-electron ionisation frequency at n_g = 1e20 was nu_iz = S/N_e = 1.2e6 s^-1 and the measured ion residence time tau_i,eff = N_i/L = 2.4 us, so nu_iz tau = 2.9 > 1 and the plasma avalanches at any density (observed e-folding 1.1 us; loss fraction f = L/S flat at 0.30-0.35). nu_iz tau = 1 at n_g = 3.4e19; at the user's 5e19 mark it is still 1.45 (runaway unless T_e falls). n_g = 1.5e19 gives nu_iz tau = 0.44 at the observed T_e, a 2.3x margin against a hotter electron population at lower collisionality, and an approach time constant tau/(1 - nu_iz tau) = 4.3 us. Static uniform background (~0.002 mg/s equivalent effusion through the 2 mm bore at 300 K)
operating_point.electron_injection_justification: sub-critical (nu_iz tau < 1) discharge sustained by the injected beam: n_eq = a tau / (1 - nu_iz tau) / V with the beam-driven ionisation a = 5e16 s^-1 at (3 mA, 1e20) measured before the avalanche (t = 0.25 us; ~2.7 ionisations per injected electron), scaling as n_g x I_inj: at 1.5e19 and 3 mA a = 7.5e15 s^-1 and n_eq = 9.3e16 m^-3 = 0.23 x n_max; if the rate coefficient were 1.5x (2x) higher n_eq = 1.5e17 (4.2e17), still under (at) the a-priori ceiling and 13x under the runtime gate density

numerics.dt_justification: as v1.1 (v2): omega_pe dt = 0.054 at the design ceiling n_max = 4e17; the runtime gate (0.2 on the instantaneous peak node density) trips at 5.6e18 m^-3, 14x the ceiling, so shot noise on the axis nodes does not stop the run
numerics.poisson: device block-Thomas direct (exact to round-off, true-residual contract 1e-10 |rhs| verified at every host sync)
numerics.averaging_window_note: consecutive 400000-step (0.6 us) windows; the reported maps are the last completed window (or the current one if at least half full)
numerics.checkpoint_note: checkpoint-latest.{json,npz} rewritten atomically every 40000 steps (60 ns, ~1-2 min wall); series.jsonl and status.jsonl are appended at every 200-step sync; a resume reloads the checkpoint (bitwise dynamical state) and the series history and restarts the map window and the interval ledger at the resume step

budget_v1_2.particles_at_n_eq: 2 x 9.3e16 x 3.46e-7 m^3 / 3e4 = 2.1 M macro-particles (e- + Xe+) at the projected n_eq; 3.4 M if n_eq is 1.5x higher
budget_v1_2.ion_transit_note: the MEASURED ion residence time N_i / L of the v2 fine cases (2.35-2.43 us after 1 us), not the Bohm/free-fall estimate (1 us) used in v2
budget_v1_2.approach_note: tau / (1 - nu_iz tau) at the projected nu_iz tau = 0.44; the 5 % / trailing-20 % plateau criterion is met at ~2.8 time constants = 12 us = 8.0e6 steps, after the required 3 transit times (7.2 us = 4.8e6 steps)

kinetic_sizing_from_v2.loss_fraction_f: 0.30 at 0.25 us, 0.35 at 0.5 us, 0.31 at 0.75 us, 0.30 at 1.0 us, 0.33 at 1.25 us, 0.35 at 1.5 us; trailing-half slope 0.03-0.07 per us (not approaching 1)

stopping_rule.plateau: relative drift < 5 % over the trailing 20 % of the elapsed simulated time for both the discharge current and the plasma electron count (linear fit over the trailing window, drift = slope x window / |mean|), evaluated at every checkpoint; may only be declared after >= 3 ion transit times (3 x 2.4 us)
stopping_rule.fail_closed: runtime omega_pe dt gate, one-cell Courant crossing, Poisson residual contract: PIC2DStabilityError ends the run with stop_reason runtime_stability_gate_stopped_run; the artifacts are still written

simplifications: static uniform neutral background (no depletion, no neutral flow): at n_g = 1.5e19 and the projected S ~ 1.3e16 s^-1 (beam 7.5e15 + plasma 5.8e15) the channel inventory (5.2e12 neutrals) is depleted at ~0.25 % per us, i.e. ~3 % over a 12 us run - reported, not modelled
no ion-neutral collisions (elastic or charge exchange)
electron-neutral: isotropic elastic without the 2 m_e/M energy loss, one lumped 8.32 eV excitation, single ionisation with Vahedi-Surendra secondary energy and isotropic emission
dielectric wall: perfectly absorbing with accumulated surface charge, zero field in the dielectric backing (perfect insulator), no secondary electron emission, no sputtering
exit plane: Dirichlet 0 V cathode/neutraliser reference; electrons injected there as a flux-weighted half-Maxwellian at fixed current
anode: perfectly absorbing conductor at fixed potential
cone wall represented as a one-cell stair-step of the plasma cell mask
prescribed static B from the P2 solution (no plasma-induced field); bilinear node interpolation of the C1 bicubic psi field
ions pushed every 8 steps with 8 dt (frozen in between; births added to the ion charge immediately)
electrostatic only, azimuthally symmetric: no azimuthal instabilities/anomalous transport
momentum-conserving bilinear scheme: energy is not exactly conserved; the ledger (with electrode work) residual is reported; a resume restarts the interval ledger

sub-critical operating point (nu_iz tau < 1) sustained by 3 mA of injected electrons at n_g = 1.5e19 m^-3 (a real CFT runs at 0.1-1 A and higher neutral density; the approach to a kinetic steady state, not the absolute current, is the object of this run)
single grid (60x480) and weight: no convergence pair in this run (the v2 coarse grid showed grid heating)
development/screening run: not preregistered, no experimental validation, not a performance prediction
